header: What ships with every Vertex Supply seat

items.title: Unlimited work orders
items.description_text: No per-job or per-close fee, whether a technician logs three calls in a day or eleven.

items.title: Offline mobile app
items.description_text: Jobs, forms, photos and asset history cached on the device, on both iOS and Android.

items.title: Asset register with QR labels
items.description_text: Printable labels that open a unit's full service record in a single scan on site.

items.title: Accounting export
items.description_text: Weekly or on-close transfers to DATEV, BMD and Sage 50, with parts and hours split out.

items.title: Support in German and English
items.description_text: Answers within two business hours, 07:00 to 19:00 CET, Monday to Friday.

items.title: Data hosted in the EU
items.description_text: Frankfurt and Vienna data centres, replicated between the two, ISO 27001 since 2023.
